query:
WITH '<namespace_here>' as namespace,
  ['FQDN', 'FQDN-Pattern'] as target_kinds
MATCH p = (n :Namespace {displayname: namespace})-[:EndpointsWithSelector]->(:EndpointSelector)-[e]->(t)-[*0..2]->()
WHERE type(e) IN ['Egress', 'EgressDeny']
AND t.primarykind IN target_kinds
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
name: Cilium Namespace - Egress to specific node kind (EndpointSelector)
description: Egress from endpoint selectors to specific kinds (e.g., CIDR, FQDN, etc.) for a specific namespace. Modify the target_kinds array below to the desired kinds.
